description:
New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma just retired the 'Microsoft Gaming' brand and laid out her plan to reset Xbox after years of chaos under Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond. The 'We Are Xbox' memo blames the last five years for everything. But under the new logo, the structure looks the same.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
